definitions.explanation: Describes a sound that is clear, loud, and carries far. Often implies a bold or confident quality to the sound.

examples.japanese: {勝利|しょうり}を{高|たか}らかに{宣言|せんげん}した。
{選手|せんしゅ}たちは{優勝|ゆうしょう}トロフィーを{高|たか}らかに{掲|かか}げ、{観客|かんきゃく}の{歓声|かんせい}に{応|こた}えた。
examples.english: The players held the championship trophy up high and responded to the cheers of the crowd.

notes:
A na-adjective, but used almost exclusively in the adverbial form {高|たか}らかに. The na-adjective form ({高|たか}らかな) is rare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高|たか}らかに{笑|わら}う (laugh out loud)
- {高|たか}らかに{宣言|せんげん}する (declare triumphantly)
- {高|たか}らかに{歌|うた}う (sing out boldly)
- {高|たか}らかに{掲|かか}げる (hold up high, display proudly)

USAGE NOTES:
Conveys confidence, boldness, or triumph. The に form functions as an adverb modifying the following verb. Distinguished from simply {高|たか}く (high/loud) by its literary and dramatic tone — {高|たか}らかに implies a deliberate, proud quality, not just volume.
